popup.exclusions.title: Confirm Exclusions
popup.exclusions.reinclude_body: These mods will be managed again and their hotkeys will be relocated. Restart Skyrim afterward so they reload cleanly.
popup.exclusions.restore_preview_intro: Choose which settings to restore for the newly excluded mods:
popup.exclusions.success_body: Changes applied successfully! It is highly recommended to restart Skyrim so the mods reload their native configurations cleanly.
popup.launcher_hotkey_options.title: Launcher Hotkey Options
exclusions.description: Excluding mods releases their keys back to the game.
settings.open_in_console: Can open menu while console is open
settings.keep_game_running: Keep the game running while menu is open
hotkey.controller_modifier_help: Press a separate button to hold with the main controller button.
conflict.hold_too_short: Hold must be longer than 350 ms to share this key with a tap shortcut.
tooltip.trigger_mode: Trigger mode (single / double / hold) and hold time
tooltip.language: Choose the language file this mod should load. Changes apply immediately.
tooltip.font_scale: Scales only menu text. UI Scale still changes both layout and text.
tooltip.easy_close: By default, if modifiers, double-tap, or hold are set to open, they are also required to close. Enabling this makes closing always a single press of the key under all settings.
tooltip.advanced_bindings_edited: Advanced Bindings (edited: modifiers or trigger mode set)
tooltip.launcher_clash_reason:
Can't enable: this key is the launcher hotkey.
Click the key to rebind it to something else.
tooltip.remember_sub_menu:
When on, a mod's sub-menu (e.g. Community Shaders) stays open after you
close and reopen the launcher, until you press Back.
tooltip.open_in_console: Open the launcher while the console is up. Use the mouse to navigate.
tooltip.show_console_hotkey_prompt: Shows the launcher hotkey when the Skyrim console opens.
tooltip.keep_game_running: Keep the world moving (animations, fire) instead of pausing.
tooltip.show_exclusions_tab: Displays a dedicated 'Exclusions' tab where you can opt-out specific mods from being managed by this menu.
tooltip.enable_logging:
The full troubleshooting log.
Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\RisaAllInOneMenu.log
tooltip.log_file_changes:
Records configuration files changed by this mod.
Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\RisaAllInOneMenu_FileChanges.log
tooltip.restore_originals:
Restore the user settings captured before this mod changed them.
Missing captured values use the original mod defaults.
tooltip.restore_defaults:
Ignore captured user settings and restore every managed setting
to the original default provided by the supported mod.
restore.defaults_done: All managed settings restored to their original mod defaults.
restore.originals_done: All managed settings restored to the user's original settings.
restore.backup_removed: The originals backup was archived as completed so a future install starts fresh.
restore.quit_then_disable: Quit Skyrim, then disable this mod before the next launch.
restore.exit_prompt: Do you want to exit the game now?
restore.confirm_defaults: Restore the supported mods' original defaults and ignore captured user settings?
restore.confirm_originals: Restore the user settings captured before this mod changed them?
restore.incomplete: Restore was incomplete. The originals backup was kept; check the logs and retry.
help.title: Information
help.dragging.title: Window
help.dragging.move: Drag the title bar to move it.
help.dragging.resize: Drag an edge or corner to resize it.
help.dragging.unsnap: Double-click the title bar to unsnap it from other windows.
help.controller.title: Controller
help.launcher_edit.title: Launcher Editing
help.launcher_edit.rename: Select a mod name to rename it.
help.launcher_edit.visibility: : show or hide its launcher button without disabling its hotkey
help.launcher_edit.save: : save edits; Reset to Default restores names and visibility
help.native_menu.body: The Skyrim menu rail opens Map, Magic, Skills, Items, Quests, and Wait. Hide it in Menu Behavior.
help.remap.title: Hotkeys
help.remap.intro: Pick any key for each mod. This mod prevents key conflicts automatically.
help.colors.body: White key: ready to use. Red key: unsafe, so it's turned off.
help.colors.fallback.suffix: still open this menu until it's fixed.
help.colors.fix: Fix a red key in Advanced Bindings: add a modifier, Double Tap, or Hold.
help.advanced.intro: Click the keyboard icon next to a hotkey to open Advanced Bindings.
help.advanced.status: Colored icon: customized. Plain icon: default single press.
help.original_hotkey.body: Enabled toggle: turns that mod's hotkey on or off. The launcher button always works either way.
help.exclusions.title: Exclusions & Restore
help.exclusions.body: Exclude a mod to stop managing it, then restore either your old settings or that mod's defaults.
help.backup.body: Restore User Original Settings: back to what you had before this mod. Restore Original Mod Defaults: back to that mod's factory settings.
help.files.title: Files
help.files.backup: The captured settings used by Restore User Original Settings.
help.files.completed: That backup archived after a successful restore, instead of deleted.
help.files.translations: The language files shown in the language dropdown.
help.logs.title: Logs
help.logs.main: The main troubleshooting log. Turn on Enable logging in Settings, then reproduce the problem.
help.logs.filechanges: Every supported-mod config edit and restore, while Log file changes is on.
conflict.cs_shift_enter: Community Shaders always uses Shift + Enter and cannot be changed. Pick another key.
